label: otsB
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the otsB window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor otsB, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,832 to 1,911 from dnaA. Read in 533 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying otsB once); 42,640 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 93% of genes, 0.34 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 37,040 calls, named 99%, 0.14 bits; shell 4,872 calls, named 57%, 1.40 bits; cloud 728 calls, named 17%, 3.30 bits. Outside an RGP 39,222 calls, named 97%, 0.17 bits; inside an RGP 3,418 calls, named 49%, 2.27 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 30 fork, 49 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (2.27 against 0.17 bits) and names fewer genes (49% against 97%); 3,418 of the 42,640 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 34 (yebB, a variable column) 0.73 bits, RGP 15%; column 24 (torZ, a variable column) 0.66 bits, RGP 3%; column 35 (yobI, a variable column) 0.62 bits, RGP 14%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 1 spine column: named 99.8%, 0.11 bits on average; the 79 fork and variable columns: named 93%, 0.34 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 34, is a variable column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: otsB. named 99.8%; 0.11 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: share 59-89%, 75 P, 4 S, RGP 0-15%. named 30-99.6% (mean 93%), fewest named at column 10, named 30%; most hesitant at column 34, 0.73 bits.
